briefing.headline: SID rockets 25% overnight as small‑cap tokens lead the move
briefing.summary: Mega‑cap tech showed mixed performance, with NVDA down 3.338% while TSLA, META and AMZN posted modest gains of around 2% each. Broad market indices SPY and QQQ were essentially flat, drifting up 0.008% and down 0.027% respectively. The strongest activity came from niche and small‑cap tokens, led by SID up 25.217% and AFYA up 19.172%, indicating a risk‑on tilt among the more speculative names.
